audition_voice_designs.tts_instruction: A warm middle-aged feminine voice with a soft Irish-influenced international English accent. Natural conversational rhythm, intimate but not theatrical, emotionally responsive, with gentle breaths and small hesitations where the meaning calls for them.

A grounded middle-aged masculine voice speaking clear West African English. Observant, personable and lightly humorous, with lively human phrasing, natural changes of pace, and restrained emotional warmth rather than announcer polish.

A young adult androgynous voice speaking natural Indian English. Intimate, earnest and curious, with expressive timing, believable uncertainty, soft laughter only when appropriate, and a close conversational presence.

An older adult feminine voice speaking clear Caribbean English. Reflective and resilient with unforced warmth, textured pauses, audible thoughtfulness, and a full emotional range that never becomes melodramatic.

A young adult masculine voice speaking conversational Singapore English. Curious and quick-witted, with playful timing, genuine small laughs when earned, energetic reactions, and natural speech rather than a performed caricature.

An older adult androgynous voice with a natural Northern English accent. Restrained, dryly funny and capable of tenderness, with lived-in pacing, subtle sighs and hesitations, and no broadcast-style smoothness.

A young adult feminine voice speaking fluent Spanish-influenced international English. Open, animated and empathetic, with spontaneous emotional shifts, natural breath, and friendly spoken-word intimacy without exaggerating the accent.

An older adult masculine voice speaking clear East African English. Calm, insightful and quietly expressive, with grounded pauses, delicate emotional changes and conversational directness rather than formal narration.
